arxiv-2209-00617.title: Fair mapping
arxiv-2209-00617.creator: Sébastien Gambs, Rosin Claude Ngueveu
arxiv-2209-00617.description: Abstract . To mitigate the effects of undesired biases in models, several approaches propose to pre-process the input dataset to reduce the risks of discrimination by preventing the inference of sensitive attributes. Unfortunately, most of these pre-processing methods lead to the generation a new distribution that is very different from the original one, thus often leading to unrealistic data.

arxiv-2402-09578.title: Comparison of three different camera systems monitoring the meteor activity over Hungary in 2020-2023
arxiv-2402-09578.creator: Lívia Deme, Krisztián Sárneczky, Antal Igaz, Balázs Csák, Nándor Opitz, Nóra Egei, József Vinkó (HUN-REN CSFK Konkoly Observatory)
arxiv-2402-09578.description: Abstract We present statistical analysis of visual meteor data taken with networks of meteor cameras operating in Hungary between 2020 and 2023. We use three different camera systems: a set of traditional MetRec-based video cameras, a self-developed automated DSLR camera system and a network of newly installed AllSky7 camera stations.

arxiv-2407-06839.title: A Mamba-based Siamese Network for Remote Sensing Change Detection
arxiv-2407-06839.creator: Jay N. Paranjape, Celso de Melo, Vishal M. Patel
arxiv-2407-06839.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jay N. Paranjape, Celso de Melo, Vishal M. Patel. Change detection in remote sensing images is an essential tool for analyzing a region at different times. It finds varied applications in monitoring environmental changes, man-made changes as well as corresponding decision-making and prediction of future trends. Deep learning methods like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transformers have achieved remarkable success in detecting significant changes, given two images at different times.

arxiv-2409-07805.title: Extremely Dense Gas around Little Red Dots and High-redshift AGNs: A Non-stellar Origin of the Balmer Break and Absorption Features
arxiv-2409-07805.creator: Kohei Inayoshi, Roberto Maiolino
arxiv-2409-07805.description: Abstract The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has uncovered low-luminosity active galactic nuclei (AGNs) at high redshifts of z ≳ 4 − 7 z\gtrsim 4-7 , powered by accreting black holes (BHs) with masses of ∼ 10 6 − 8 ​ M ⊙ \sim 10^{6-8}~M_{\odot} .

arxiv-2504-16564.title: SAIP-Net: Enhancing Remote Sensing Image Segmentation via Spectral Adaptive Information Propagation
arxiv-2504-16564.creator: Zhongtao Wang, Xizhe Cao, Yisong Chen, Guoping Wang
arxiv-2504-16564.description: Abstract Semantic segmentation of remote sensing imagery demands precise spatial boundaries and robust intra-class consistency, challenging conventional hierarchical models. To address limitations arising from spatial domain feature fusion and insufficient receptive fields, this paper introduces SAIP-Net, a novel frequency-aware segmentation framework that leverages Spectral Adaptive Information Propagation.

arxiv-2511-02268.title: Localized to delocalized spatial quantum correlation evolution in structured bright twin beams
arxiv-2511-02268.creator: Jerin A Thachil, Chirang R. Patel, U. Ashwin, Ashok Kumar
arxiv-2511-02268.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jerin A Thachil, Chirang R. Patel, U. Ashwin, Ashok Kumar. Quantum correlations in the spatial domain hold great promise for applications in quantum imaging, quantum cryptography and quantum information processing, owing to the infinite dimensionality of the associated Hilbert space. Here, we present a theoretical investigation, complemented by experimental measurements, of the propagation dynamics of the spatial quantum correlations in bright structured twin beams generated via a four-wave mixing process in a double- Λ \Lambda configuration in atomic vapor.

arxiv-2511-03036.creator: Ognjen Papaz, Duško Jojić

arxiv-2511-16162.title: Layer-wise Noise Guided Selective Wavelet Reconstruction for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2511-16162.creator: Yuting Lu, Ziliang Wang, Weixin Xu, Wei Zhang, Yongqiang Zhao, Yang Yu, Xiaohong Zhang
arxiv-2511-16162.description: Abstract Clinical deployment requires segmentation models to stay stable under distribution shifts and perturbations. The mainstream solution is adversarial training (AT) to improve robustness; however, AT often brings a clean–robustness trade-off and high training/tuning cost, which limits scalability and maintainability in medical imaging. We propose Layer-wise Noise-Guided Selective Wavelet Reconstruction (LNG-SWR) .

arxiv-2512-04434.title: Predicting Time-Dependent Flow Over Complex Geometries Using Operator Networks Journal: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
arxiv-2512-04434.creator: Ali Rabeh, Suresh Murugaiyan, Adarsh Krishnamurthy, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian
arxiv-2512-04434.description: Abstract Fast, geometry-generalizing surrogates for unsteady flow remain challenging. We present a time-dependent, geometry-aware Deep Operator Network that predicts velocity fields for moderate-Re flows around parametric and non-parametric shapes. The model encodes geometry via a signed distance field (SDF) trunk and flow history via a CNN branch, trained on 841 high-fidelity simulations.

pmc-11478058.title: Coal to Clean: Comparing Advanced Electrodes for Desulfurization and Copper Recovery
pmc-11478058.creator: Katarina R Pantović Spajić, Marijana R Pantović Pavlović, Srecko Stopic, Vesna S Cvetković, Nataša M Petrović, Branislav Marković, Miroslav M Pavlović, Arihant Bhandari
pmc-11478058.description: This study explores the electrochemical desulfurization of coal and the recovery of copper (Cu) using dimensionally stable anode (DSA) electrodes. Background: The research addresses the need for effective sulfur removal from coal to reduce emissions. Methods: Electrochemical desulfurization was conducted using DSA and graphite electrodes, evaluating parameters like activation energy, desulfurization rate, and energy consumption.

pmc-12524402.creator: Georgios Malis, Christina N Banti, Alexia Tialiou, Michael R Reithofer, Antonios G Hatzidimitriou, Sotiris K Hadjikakou, Konstantina C Fylaktakidou, George Psomas, Marija Plješa-Ercegovac
pmc-12524402.description: The reaction of 4′–bromo-fenamic acid, a bromo-derivative of fenamic acid (the scaffold of the fenamate non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), with Co(II) in the absence or presence of various nitrogen-donor ligands yielded nine novel, neutral mononuclear Co(II) complexes. These complexes were characterized by physicochemical and spectroscopic techniques and single-crystal X-ray crystallography.

pmc-12656864.title: Pathogenesis and Transmissibility of Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronaviruses of African Origin in Alpacas
pmc-12656864.creator: Richard A Bowen, Airn Hartwig, Anneliese Bruening, Audrey Walker, Malik Peiris, Ronald N Harty
pmc-12656864.description: The Middle East Respiratory Syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) remains a highly significant threat to global public health. Dromedary camels are the zoonotic source of human infection. All cases of zoonotic Middle East Respiratory Syndrome (MERS) have occurred in Middle Eastern countries despite MERS-CoV infection of camels being widespread in Africa.

pmc-13458775.creator: Shinya Arataki, Akiyoshi Miyamoto, Tadashi Komatsubara, Masato Tanaka
pmc-13458775.description: Morbid obesity increases operative depth and soft-tissue thickness in lumbar spine surgery, potentially complicating portal placement and working-corridor stability in unilateral biportal endoscopic (UBE) procedures.
